2. Pane 3 includes the two staged local commits in the next specialists npm release (xtrm-efa2a.1 + xtrm-vu2ro.1 — container makes both safe to ship).
3. Next pane-2 session: close stale handoff beads (xtrm-c4fqp, xtrm-mp0f2, xtrm-t2530, xtrm-drdg6) carried over from yesterday's report.
4. Defer: file follow-up bd to retire reusable workflow's auto-reconcile job once container fully owns Mercury auto-reconcile (Phases 7/8 of container ramp).

**Prior SSOT:** `.xtrm/reports/2026-06-25-4d5625ff.md` (yesterday's release-prep/Phase-C closeout).
